items.title: Kalyan Jewellers launches initiative to help reduce annual gold imports by 5 tonnes
items.description: Kerala-headquartered firm forms four-pillar framework to activate dormant household gold, reduce import dependence, and reimagine gold as a renewable domestic resource

items.title: PM's appeal to delay gold purchase can impact short-term demand, says Titan CFO
items.description: Titan and other jewellery stocks plunged up to 10% on May 11 following the PM’s appeal to defer gold purchases

items.title: As foreign travel slows, IHCL doubles down on domestic tourism story
items.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call to tourists to defer international travel could spell good news for hotels, as it may encourage more domestic activity, chief financial officer Ankur Dalwani has said

items.title: The end of frictionless AI globalisation
items.description: China’s blocking of Meta’s acquisition of Manus is not just about one AI startup. It signals a deeper technological schism in which national security is increasingly reshaping the future of global technology markets.

items.title: Block deal in Groww upsized to around $600 million on high demand
items.description: A mix of sovereign wealth funds, global long only funds, mutual funds and life insurance firms had participated in the large block trade, a source aware of the development said.

items.title: Banks seek promoter company guarantees, fresh viability report in Vodafone Idea loan talks
items.description: The renewed lender discussions come after the DoT finalised Vodafone Idea’s AGR dues at Rs 64,046 crore, significantly lower than the earlier Rs 87,695 crore

items.title: Chart of the Day: India pharma market gets a growth boost from weight loss drugs
items.description: Monthly sales of anti-diabetic medicines crossed Rs 2,000 crore in April 2026

items.title: Saiyaara's success, love for Laalo — smaller films are Durandhars as PVR INOX clocks a strong FY26
items.description: The turnaround story of FY26 was Hindi films, which saw a 55% growth in box office collections driven by consistent Bollywood performance across small to big films

items.title: Cinemas may benefit from PM Modi's 'vocal for local' call, say PVR INOX promoters
items.description: Ajay Bijli, Managing Director of PVR INOX, believes cinema historically performs well during periods of uncertainty.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI exec Sutskever says he spent a year gathering proof of alleged Sam Altman dishonesty
items.description: During his testimony in a legal fight between OpenAI and Elon Musk, the top AI researcher confirmed he had been thinking about taking action to remove Altman as CEO for at least one year prior to his November 2023 board vote to oust Altman.

items.title: PM’s austerity measures can help stimulate domestic travel: IHCL chief Puneet Chhatwal
items.description: Company plans to open 60 new hotels in FY27, plans capex of Rs 1,200 crore to drive double-digit growth during the year; May look at upward revising 2030 targets
